title: Square root of the influence threshold
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $\varepsilon>0$, and let $k$ be a natural number. If the total influence of the real-valued version of $f$ is positive, then the square root of its threshold $\varepsilon^2/I(f)^2\cdot 9^{-k}$ equals $\varepsilon/I(f)\cdot(1/3)^k$, where $I(f)$ denotes that total influence.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
